name: Skyline Trail, Cape Breton Highlands
region: Cape Breton Highlands National Park, Nova Scotia
why: Through boreal forest with moose to a boardwalk down a headland 400 m above the Gulf of St. Lawrence, where pilot whales pass below at sunset.
book: Parking reservation for the Skyline trailhead in season (online or by phone, Parks Canada), plus the park pass.
dangers: Moose on the trail: keep 30 m away.
Coyotes: walk in groups, keep children close.

points.name: Skyline trailhead
points.note: A parking area on the Cabot Trail on top of French Mountain.

points.name: Skyline headland
points.note: A boardwalk stepping down a bare ridge above the sea and the Cabot Trail.

points.name: Northern loop
points.note: The return half of the loop, through low spruce and open barrens with the coast to the north.
